title: Implement bounded candle and indicator warmup state diagnostics
description:
Implement bounded warmup state tracking and data-quality gating diagnostics in mike_trade/market_data/warmup.py, with unit tests in tests/unit/test_warmup.py.

Required behavior:
- A WarmupTracker keeps per-(symbol, timeframe) state and computes per-requirement readiness from declared needs: required completed-bar counts per timeframe, plus indicator warmup lengths from the h.2 calculators' warmup_bars. It uses only bounded buffers (deque maxlen or equivalent) and never stores an unbounded bar history.
- States: COLD → WARMING → READY, plus DEGRADED and INVALID. Transitions are deterministic: the same ordered input sequence and injected clock always produce identical states and diagnostics.
- An immutable WarmupDiagnostics snapshot reports, per symbol and requirement: bars_have / bars_needed, state, and a tuple of blocking reason codes. Reason codes include at least INSUFFICIENT_BARS, STALE_DATA, MISSING_DATA, BAR_GAP, ZERO_VOLUME, INVALID_OHLC, MIXED_FEED, UNCLOSED_BAR, PRICE_BASIS_MISMATCH, SESSION_NOT_REGULAR, and UNKNOWN_SESSION.
- The buy_gate(symbol, context) decision returns allowed=True only when every declared requirement is READY and there are no blocking reasons. Otherwise it fails closed with reason codes. Specifically:
  - stale or missing context, a gap in completed 1-minute bars within the current session, a zero-volume bar where the requirement declares volume relevance, invalid OHLC, mixed feed_id, an unclosed bar offered as completed, an adjusted/raw basis mismatch, or a non-regular/unknown session must each block BUY
  - session VWAP readiness requires bars from the current session_id, and resets at a session change
- The gate is for new entries only. The module must expose no API that blocks exits, fills, stops, reconciliation, or manual closes; document this in the module docstring.
- Support seeding from historical completed bars (for example replay or REST warmup) followed by live bars. Seeding must yield the same state as feeding the same bars live.
- Consume MarketContext (h.4), Candle (h.1), indicator warmup metadata (h.2), and session info (h.3) through their public APIs only. Do no network or broker I/O. Do not invent numerical trading thresholds; bar counts come from declarations.

Before editing, inspect:
- mike_trade/market_data/context.py (h.4), mike_trade/market_data/candles.py (h.1), mike_trade/strategies/indicators/core.py (h.2), and mike_trade/scheduling/calendar.py (h.3)
- mike_trade/market_data/quality.py (if present) for existing freshness and gap reason codes to align with
- mike_trade/strategies/base.py (if present) for strategy input declarations
acceptance_criteria: A test confirms that a requirement with N bars needed reports WARMING with INSUFFICIENT_BARS at N-1 completed bars and READY at exactly N.
A test confirms that replaying an identical input sequence twice yields equal WarmupDiagnostics, and that historical seeding yields the same state as live feeding of the same bars.

Negative tests confirm that each of these causes buy_gate to return allowed=False with the matching reason code: stale context, missing context, a 1-minute bar gap, a zero-volume bar (volume-relevant requirement), invalid OHLC, mixed feed_id, an unclosed bar, a price-basis mismatch, and a non-regular or unknown session.
A positive test confirms that buy_gate returns allowed=True when all requirements are READY with fresh, regular-session, single-feed RAW-basis closed bars.
A test confirms that VWAP-dependent readiness resets when the session_id changes and requires current-session bars.
A test confirms that internal buffers stay at or below the configured bound after feeding many more bars than needed.
A test or docstring assertion confirms that the module exposes no API affecting exits, fills, stops, reconciliation, or manual closes.
WarmupDiagnostics is immutable; a test confirms that mutation raises.
forbidden_changes: change PLAN_SKELETON.json or other planning artifacts
modify candles.py, context.py, indicators/core.py, or calendar.py
block exits, fills, stops, reconciliation, or manual closes based on warmup state
store unbounded bar or tick history
perform network, provider, or broker I/O
run broad test suites or backtests
